name: Camp Taconic
description_short: Camp Taconic is a coed sleepaway camp for ages 7 to 15 on Lake Ashmere in Hinsdale, in the Berkshires. For 2027 it offers a full season from late June to mid-August, plus a four-week part season for first-summer campers only.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: 15s and LITs (leaders in training) arrive one day early, on June 26, 2027; other campers arrive June 27.
The part-season program is limited to first-summer campers only.
Sleepaway camp type is inferred from the arrival/return-home schedule, Visiting Day and the 'Local Lodging' link; the page does not state it explicitly.
The camp has separate summer (Hinsdale, MA) and winter (Pearl River, NY) addresses; the summer camp location is the one recorded.
unknowns: Camper age or grade range (page refers to groups like 'LC - 14s', '15s' and 'LITs' without defining them)
Whether sessions have open spots, a waitlist, or are full
Transportation (e.g., camp bus from NYC area)
What tuition includes and any extra fees
